items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 5:1
items.html: (To the question) Malchut is always called by the name point, after the root Malchut, over which the first restriction was made. Therefore the aspect of the very subject of the restriction and screen, over which the coupling is made, is called everywhere by the name point. (p. 490, Item 8. And in the Inner Light, s.v. "points".)
